decisions.reason: The battery-efficiency goal does not change the existing AXP2101 thermal-pad cooling requirement.
Maximizing battery life does not alter the specified overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal protection behavior.
The efficiency objective does not change the panel button connector, signal, location, or switching behavior.
The source does not resolve or modify the battery connector's family, pinout, accessibility, or NTC contact.
The general battery-life objective does not specify a different DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or regulation behavior.
This requirement applies to standalone USB operation without the power board, and the source does not change its regulator or powered loads.
The switched rail already has its own control and intermittent-operation rules; the source supplies no new rail behavior or parameter.
The battery-efficiency goal does not change the required charge-status indication circuit or its components.
Although sleep behavior affects battery use, the source refers to efficiency of the power-management solution and specifies no change to ESP32 sleep or wake policy.
The efficiency objective does not alter which rails are monitored or the monitoring-channel configuration.
The source constrains power-management efficiency but does not change the single-board or three-board architecture.
The source does not change LED supply voltage, data drive, standby-current behavior, or component selection.
